notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) - robots.txt (www.fabindia.com/robots.txt) allows all crawlers except operational paths (cart/checkout/search/login/wishlist etc), no Claude/anthropic-bot disallow, so all tiers permitted. Direct curl fetch of the homepage without pinning the IP returned a WRONG tenant's page (nilkamalhomes.com content) due to Fastly anycast routing variance; re-fetching with --resolve to a stable edge IP returned the correct Fabindia page (confirmed via <title>). Site is SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) + Angular Universal/Spartacus storefront (baseSiteId=fabindiab2c) - the SSR HTML shell ships an empty product/nav state (hydrates client-side), so tier (a) alone could not see the real mega-menu or counts. TREE: used a short Playwright (tier b) pass to render the homepage, expand the DOM nav, and capture the storefront's own CMS navigation JSON (apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/cms/components/FabIndiaCategoryNavComponent/navigationnode) which returned the full 2-level Home & Living menu verbatim (group headings + children). Cross-checked against sitemap-category.xml (3900 URLs, /home/* segment had 354, many duplicated as new-*/sale-* filter views which were excluded as non-category filtered views) which surfaced additional 3rd-level catalog categories not shown in the 2-level menu (Utility Boxes, Tissue Boxes, Storage/Laundry/Fruit/Bread/Picnic Baskets, Napkins, Table Covers, Mats, Runners under Table Linen, Kitchen Linen, Shower Curtains & Caps, Carryalls, Upholstery & Curtain Fabrics, Yoga Mats). QTY/EVIDENCE: reverted to tier (a) direct HTTP JSON calls against the storefront's own OCC REST API (https://apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/products/search?query=:relevance:allCategories:<categoryCode>&pageSize=0) - categoryCode equals the URL slug; response gives exact pagination.totalResults plus breadcrumbCategories confirming each node's name and parent chain (used as the h1/canonical-equivalent confirmation). Verified internal consistency by summing each parent's children totalResults against the parent's own totalResults - all matched exactly (bed-linen 429 = sum of 6 children; cushions 404 = sum of 5; bath 245 = sum of 5 incl. shower-curtains-caps; table-linen 433 = sum of 4; floor-coverings 125 = sum of 2; storage-utility 32 = boxes 21 + baskets 6 + carryalls 5; boxes 21 = tissue-boxes 15 + utility-boxes 6; baskets 6 = storage-baskets 2 + laundry-baskets 4), confirming no missing siblings. Sampled product names via the same API for every ambiguous node before deciding. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): entire Clothing/Women/Men/Kids/Beauty/Food/Furniture top-level sections (out of scope); within Home & Living - Lighting group (Table/Floor/Hanging Lamps, Lampshades), Home Decor group (Candles, Incense, Diyas/Lamps/Lanterns, Vases, Photo Frames, Clocks, Accents, Hardwares, Mirrors & Wall Art, Garden), Kitchen & Dining's Dinner & Serveware/Drinkware/Kitchenware/Dining Accessories (sampled Dining Accessories = wooden/metal coasters, trivets, servers - non-textile decor/kitchenware), Bath Accessories (sampled = mostly glass/ceramic bath sets plus a few cotton toiletry bags; majority non-textile so the node was excluded), Tissue Boxes (sampled = decorative wood/metal/fibre tissue-pack holders, no meaningful storage function, not genuine Storage per storage.md Decorative-vs-Storage boundary), Carryalls (travel/tote bags, storage.md 6 excludes personal-carrying bags), Fruit Baskets/Bread Baskets/Picnic Baskets (kitchenware/travel items, also qty=0), Yoga Mats (fitness product, qty=0), and the Accessories group's Stationery/Gift Packaging/Games & Toys/Personal Accessories (general merchandise). All Collection/Winter/Wedding/Summer/Indigo/PM Vishwakarma/Gifting/Sale/New Arrivals nav nodes were skipped as promotional/filtered views per the View-All/Collections rule, not independent categories. No blocks encountered on any tier.
